multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: The five-surface envelope is structural. Execution is limited to field-originated behavior, required readback, shared contract regression boundaries, and proven prerequisites.

evidenceIndex.claim: Exact-ref/root-cause/evidence protocol governs remote execution.
evidenceIndex.result: Use current branch/ref truth and invalidate stale evidence after writes.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove product runtime.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current package framework requires pinned truth, bounded causal scope, current schema and strict evidence.
evidenceIndex.result: Package must include only field-required effects and current generator/validator shape.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Package creation itself does not execute product changes.

evidenceIndex.claim: Pinned diagnosis baseline for field-3.
evidenceIndex.result: Branch was resolved before package creation planning.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Must be re-resolved before the atomic write and before execution/closure.

evidenceIndex.claim: Prior field package contains useful historical provenance but stale assumptions.
evidenceIndex.result: Reuse evidence selectively; do not inherit closure status or old blocker assumptions.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Old candidate-bound PASS is stale after later branch movement.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current app-field test command runs tests/*.test.mjs plus runtime contract and the test directory exists.
evidenceIndex.result: Old 'no tests' blocker is obsolete; current gate needs candidate-bound execution, not reconstruction.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static source does not prove current command success.

evidenceIndex.source: GitHub Actions PR #239 Node verification log
evidenceIndex.claim: Frozen pnpm install currently fails in root postinstall with Self-referencing circular pointer during OpenAPI client materialization.
evidenceIndex.result: OpenAPI materialization is a shared prerequisite blocker for trustworthy Node verification affecting field closure.
evidenceIndex.limitations: The log identifies the failure class but not yet the exact schema/ref root cause.

evidenceIndex.claim: Postinstall composes OpenAPI contexts and invokes openapi-typescript for registered clients.
evidenceIndex.result: Fix must target the bad canonical contract/composition path, not bypass postinstall.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Requires execution to isolate exact context and pointer.

evidenceIndex.claim: Payout request contract supports FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED and does not accept a client-selected destination id.
evidenceIndex.result: Field finance UI should remain read-only for destination and WLT should resolve authoritative destination/version.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Backend authority, maker/checker and provisioning still require proof.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current partner field assignment workspace asks operators for raw Actor ID and reuses WorkforceScopeManager.
evidenceIndex.result: This is not a true onboarding-assignment business entity or operator UX.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove backend absence of every assignment-like structure; implementation must search before create.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field onboarding still carries local category/default semantics while catalog uses central taxonomy.
evidenceIndex.result: Business Vertical and catalog taxonomy need one coherent authority and publication policy.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Exact symbols must be re-resolved on execution candidate.

evidenceIndex.claim: Upload state has been presented as if verification were complete in field onboarding flow.
evidenceIndex.result: Upload and reviewer verification must be separate authoritative states.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Exact current UI text/state must be rechecked before editing.

evidenceIndex.claim: Legacy migration/quarantine and terminal-capacity behaviors have dedicated tests now.
evidenceIndex.result: Do not rebuild the queue or reopen solved legacy problems without new evidence.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Unknown-result reconciliation remains a separate concern.

evidenceIndex.claim: Governed offline replay exists for field mutations.
evidenceIndex.result: Ambiguous server outcome must reconcile canonical truth before retry where commit status is unknown.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static code is not real network-loss proof.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field runtime declares a large native dependency set.
evidenceIndex.result: Native dependency decisions require actual consumer/peer/autolinking/config/plugin evidence.
evidenceIndex.limitations: No package is removed during product implementation merely because it appears unused.

evidenceIndex.source: mobile app capability manifest/guard + Expo app configuration
evidenceIndex.claim: Declared capabilities can force dependencies/plugins/permissions even without direct app imports.
evidenceIndex.result: Native cleanup must align feature declaration, package, plugin and permission as one change.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Exact manifest/guard paths must be resolved on current candidate.

evidenceIndex.claim: Identity owns actor/session trust and Workforce governs field profile/readiness.
evidenceIndex.result: Field access must fail closed for missing/incomplete/suspended/revoked state.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Runtime and device proof required.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field-originated partner/store onboarding has bounded Control Panel, Partner and Client effects.
evidenceIndex.result: Cross-surface scope is included only where field-originated data must be reviewed/read back.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not justify unrelated Partner/Client feature work.

evidenceIndex.claim: WLT is financial truth for representative wallet/payout behavior.
evidenceIndex.result: Field finance changes must preserve WLT authority and reconciliation.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Shared Partner/Captain checks are limited to the same payout contract regression boundary.

evidenceIndex.claim: Visit/checklist mutations have governed backend handlers.
evidenceIndex.result: Existing implementation is verification-first and should be changed only for reproduced root defects.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Database/concurrency/device behavior still requires proof.

evidenceIndex.source: existing support/message primitives in DSH frontend/backend
evidenceIndex.claim: Repository already has message primitives that may be reusable for onboarding collaboration.
evidenceIndex.result: Prefer reuse/extension over a second generic chat engine when semantics fit.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Reuse decision requires exact writer/reader/auth scope inspection.

evidenceIndex.source: field draft ownership guard/current field partner API
evidenceIndex.claim: Field draft access is actor-scoped in current design.
evidenceIndex.result: Field A must never read or mutate Field B drafts/tasks, including deep-link/cache/replay paths.
evidenceIndex.limitations: List endpoints and new assignment endpoints require explicit tests.

evidenceIndex.source: user-approved execution constraint recorded for field-3
evidenceIndex.claim: Native physical removal is intentionally deferred until dependencies are proven deprecated and a consolidated native/EAS window is ready.
evidenceIndex.result: During normal field implementation use KEEP/DEPRECATED_CANDIDATE/DEPRECATED_CONFIRMED without changing native graph.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Final package closure still requires executing the planned native cleanup window if removals remain required.

evidenceIndex.source: user fail-closed closure directive for field-3
evidenceIndex.claim: Any known field-related defect, gap, contradiction, dead path, regression or unresolved executable work keeps the package OPEN.
evidenceIndex.result: Final closure requires cleanup, hardening, adversarial review and fresh end-to-end evidence from the latest execution head.
evidenceIndex.limitations: This rule does not expand scope to unrelated repository work.
